remarks: Charming 3/4 Bedroom Classic Colonial on Serene 1.4-Acre Lot  Nestled on a picturesque 1.4-acre property with a park-like yard and a covered patio, this classic Colonial home offers both elegance and comfort. The gracious living room boasts a large picture window, crown molding, and a wood-burning fireplace, creating a cozy yet sophisticated atmosphere. Adjacent to the living room, the formal dining room features built-in cabinets, perfect for displaying fine china or family heirlooms.  The custom-designed eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring a built-in banquet, granite countertops, and high-end stainless steel appliances. Off the kitchen, a built-in bar area leads to the cozy den, complete with built-in bookshelves, ideal for relaxation or casual entertaining.  Upstairs, the substantial primary suite offers a tranquil retreat with his-and-her closets and a luxurious marbled bathroom featuring an air tub, perfect for unwinding after a long day. An updated hall bath includes a steam shower, providing a spa-like experience right at home.  A bonus fourth bedroom, located above the garage and accessible through the kitchen, makes an ideal guest room or private office.  This home offers a perfect blend of space, style, and functionality, making it an ideal choice for a variety of lifestyles. Whether you're hosting guests or enjoying peaceful moments in your private retreat, this home is sure to impress.
